name: @anywalletkit/secure-storage-react-native
description: Device secret storage for React Native wallets on Any Wallet Kit: every secret in the iOS Keychain behind a Secure Enclave–checked access control or under an Android Keystore key in StrongBox / TEE that needs the user for every single read. Face ID or the device passcode by default, an opt-in strict mode (current biometrics only, dies when biometrics change), this device only, never in backups, a named biometry-changed error instead of a crash, prune after reinstall and a verified migration from any older store. Implements the keyring SecretStorage.
